scope: development workload triage; no learned models or confirmation
execution_order: round then alternating solver order then all declared inputs
selection: all generated instances and all declared solver/round observations are retained
solver_configuration: two explicit default configurations; not a tuned or state-of-the-art portfolio
cost_scope: solver construction + clause insertion + budget setup + solve + model extraction + deletion + independent witness check; process startup/IPC reported separately
gate_scope: each qualifying SAT case must return an independently valid witness in every round of both solvers; timeouts/unknowns/UNSAT reports remain in the denominator; no power or novelty claim
identity_scope: ordered and order-normalized hashes; no claim of complete variable-renaming or sign-switching equivalence
unsat_scope: UNSAT results are solver reports, not independently checked proofs
